verdict.rationale: Poly documents an official MCP server at mcp.poly.app (streamable HTTP, OAuth) that AI assistants connect to. MCP write operations are evidenced: `rm` archives files, and only permanent deletion is held back. A Claude Code plugin gives 'full access to your Poly files', and a `poly` CLI with an agent skill teaches agents to search, read, create, update, and organize files from the terminal, so headless read and write is clearly documented. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent write flows; the CLI ships only inside the desktop app; OAuth needs a one-time browser sign-in; and there is no public REST/OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404).
